motive: Mario discovered that Jesús forged the entrance exam that got him into the school and threatened to tell the Host.
truth_summary: Jesús asked Mario to meet in the library at 23:30 to 'talk it over'. When Mario refused to stay quiet, Jesús struck him with a brass bookend from the history shelf. He wiped the bookend, hid it in the infirmary laundry basket and tore the page of the sign-out log that showed his name. He then planted Chechu's apron button near the body.
crime_scene_prompt: unconscious anime boy with brown hair lying face down between tall library bookshelves, toppled wooden chair, scattered books, splashes of bright neon pink liquid on the floor, green desk lamps, dramatic shadows
host_announcement: Ding-dong! A body has been discovered in the Library! The investigation begins... now!

key_clues.name: Torn sign-out log
key_clues.description: The library sign-out log has its 23:00-24:00 page torn out. A faint pen impression of a 'J' remains on the next page.
key_clues.image_prompt: a library sign-out ledger with one page torn out, pen impressions on the next page, wooden desk

key_clues.name: Wiped brass bookend
key_clues.description: A brass bookend from the library, smelling of disinfectant, hidden in the infirmary laundry basket. One corner is dented.
key_clues.image_prompt: a dented brass owl bookend half hidden among white towels in a laundry basket

key_clues.name: Forged exam sheet
key_clues.description: Mario kept a copy of Jesús's entrance exam with a different handwriting on the answers and a note: 'Tell the Host tomorrow.'
key_clues.image_prompt: an exam paper with two different handwritings and a sticky note, on a dormitory desk

key_clues.name: Deleted message
key_clues.description: Jesús's tablet: a deleted message to Mario, 'Library, 23:30. Come alone.'
key_clues.image_prompt: a cracked tablet screen showing a chat app with a deleted message icon, neon glow

key_clues.name: Planted apron button
key_clues.description: A chef-apron button near the body. Its thread was cut cleanly with scissors, not torn in a struggle.
key_clues.image_prompt: a single black apron button with a cleanly cut thread on a wooden floor, spotlight

minor_clues.description: Chechu was cleaning the kitchen until midnight; the dishwasher log confirms it.
Pablo heard running footsteps toward the infirmary at about 23:45.
Ángela was sneaking out to the gym to practice; she hides it because it breaks curfew.
A history shelf has a gap where one of two matching brass bookends should be.

false_clues.description: Chechu's apron button found by the body.
A painting of Mario with his face scratched out.

npc_secrets.alibi: I was asleep in my dorm from 22:30.
npc_secrets.secret: Killed Mario to protect his forged exam.
Lost an apron button earlier that day in the hallway.
Had a grudge against Andrea and planted the scratched painting to frame her.
Was in the gym breaking curfew; saw Jesús pass by at 23:25.
Fought with Mario last week about a painting.
Saw the infirmary door open at 23:50.
Heard Mario say he'd 'tell the Host everything tomorrow'.
